nosotros.label: About Us
nosotros.descripcion: For generations, our family has lived by and for the sea. At El Atlante, we bring that passion to every dish, using traditional techniques and the freshest produce from the San Cristóbal fish market.
nosotros.pilar1Desc: No middlemen — straight from the fish market to your table. Fresh in under 24h.
nosotros.pilar2Desc: Recipes with soul and maritime power, inherited over decades.

carta.label: Exclusivity
carta.subtitulo: Iconic dishes that define our gastronomic identity without artifice.
carta.pulpoDesc: Our most emblematic preparation, served with local peppers and premium paprika.
carta.croquetasDesc: A burst of the sea in every bite. Extra-creamy béchamel made fresh daily.
carta.pescadoDesc: Directly sourced from the San Cristóbal boats. Traditional preparation or chef's style.
carta.polvitoDesc: The quintessential Canarian dessert. Layers of meringue, biscuit and the finest dulce de leche.
